title: Data of normalized algebraic adic towers and their local realization
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], record quotient derived objects E_n, consecutive arrows to scalar restriction, left adjoints to level and consecutive exact restriction, invertibility of the consecutive adjoint transposes, and perfectness of E_0 [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Define exact constant realization with the coefficient universe lift, its derived functor, completed constant realization followed by slice restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction], the actual restricted strict tower, and a local tower with an isomorphism of these whole diagrams. Also define the model diagram of a supplied algebraic tower and composition of a pro-etale object of an etale chart with its chart morphism. These are the unchanged data previously declared with the extraction theorem; no existence assertion is included.
